title: Physiological Signals & Wearables
blurb: ECG, PPG, EEG/sleep, heart and lung sounds, bedside waveforms and consumer-wearable recordings.

items.name: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database
items.description: 48 half-hour two-lead ambulatory ECG recordings with beat-by-beat cardiologist annotations — the reference standard for arrhythmia-detection algorithms since 1980.
items.provider: MIT / Beth Israel Hospital via PhysioNet

paper.label: Moody GB, Mark RG. IEEE Eng Med Biol Mag 2001;20:45

items.name: PTB-XL
items.description: 21,799 clinical 12-lead, 10-second ECGs from 18,869 patients with SCP-ECG diagnostic, form and rhythm statements annotated by cardiologists.

paper.label: Wagner P et al. Sci Data 2020;7:154

items.name: MIMIC-IV-ECG
items.description: ~800,000 diagnostic 12-lead ECGs from ~160,000 patients linked to MIMIC-IV, with machine measurements and cardiologist report text.
items.access_note: Direct download from PhysioNet (ODbL); linkage to clinical data needs MIMIC-IV credentialed access.

items.name: Chapman–Shaoxing 12-lead ECG Database
items.description: 12-lead ECGs from >45,000 patients at Shaoxing People's Hospital with rhythm and diagnostic labels from expert physicians.

paper.label: Zheng J et al. Sci Data 2020;7:48

items.name: CODE-15%
items.description: 345,779 12-lead ECGs from 233,770 Brazilian patients (a 15% sample of the CODE telehealth cohort) with labels for six abnormalities and mortality follow-up.
items.provider: Telehealth Network of Minas Gerais / Uppsala University

paper.label: Ribeiro AH et al. Nat Commun 2020;11:1760

items.name: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2020–2021 (12-lead ECG)
items.description: ~88,000 annotated ECGs pooled from multiple international databases (CPSC, INCART, PTB, Georgia, Chapman, Ningbo) with SNOMED-CT diagnostic labels.

paper.label: Perez Alday EA et al. Physiol Meas 2020;41:124003

items.name: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2017 (AF)
items.description: 8,528 short single-lead ECGs from AliveCor devices labelled normal, AF, other rhythm or noisy.

paper.label: Clifford GD et al. Comput Cardiol 2017;44

items.name: Icentia11k
items.description: Continuous single-lead ECG from 11,000 patients (up to two weeks each) with ~2.7 billion labelled beats — a huge resource for self-supervised ECG learning.

paper.label: Tan S et al. arXiv 2019

items.name: MIMIC-III & MIMIC-IV Waveform Databases
items.description: Bedside-monitor waveforms (ECG, ABP, PPG, respiration) and numeric trends recorded from ICU patients, partly matched to the clinical databases.

items.name: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset
items.description: 53 eight-minute recordings of ECG, PPG and impedance pneumography with manual breath annotations, extracted from MIMIC-II.

paper.label: Pimentel MAF et al. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2017;64:1914

items.name: Sleep-EDF Expanded
items.description: 197 whole-night polysomnographic recordings (EEG, EOG, chin EMG) with hypnograms scored by technicians — the standard sleep-staging benchmark.

paper.label: Kemp B et al. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2000;47:1185

items.name: National Sleep Research Resource (NSRR)
items.description: Polysomnography and clinical data from >40,000 sleep studies across major cohorts (SHHS, MESA, CFS, CHAT, MrOS, APPLES).
items.access_note: Free; online data access request with signed Data Access and Use Agreement.

paper.label: Zhang GQ et al. JAMIA 2018;25:1351

items.name: Apnea-ECG Database
items.description: 70 overnight single-lead ECG recordings with minute-by-minute apnoea annotations for ECG-based sleep-apnoea detection.

items.name: CTU-UHB Intrapartum Cardiotocography Database
items.description: 552 intrapartum CTG recordings (fetal heart rate and uterine contractions) with umbilical-artery pH and clinical outcomes from Brno University Hospital.
items.provider: Czech Technical University / University Hospital Brno

paper.label: Chudáček V et al. BMC Pregnancy Childbirth 2014;14:16

items.name: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2016 (Heart Sounds)
items.description: 3,000+ phonocardiogram recordings from multiple databases labelled normal or abnormal.

paper.label: Liu C et al. Physiol Meas 2016;37:2181

items.name: CirCor DigiScope Phonocardiogram Dataset
items.description: 5,272 heart-sound recordings from 1,568 children in Brazil with murmur annotations (timing, grade, shape) by experts.

paper.label: Oliveira J et al. IEEE J Biomed Health Inform 2022;26:2524

items.name: ICBHI 2017 Respiratory Sound Database
items.description: 920 annotated lung-sound recordings from 126 patients (healthy, COPD, asthma, pneumonia, etc.) with crackle and wheeze labels.
items.provider: ICBHI / Aristotle University of Thessaloniki & University of Coimbra

paper.label: Rocha BM et al. Physiol Meas 2019;40:035001

items.name: COUGHVID
items.description: 25,000+ crowdsourced cough recordings with self-reported COVID-19 status and expert annotations on a subset.

paper.label: Orlandic L et al. Sci Data 2021;8:156

items.name: Coswara
items.description: Breathing, cough, vowel and counting audio from ~2,700 Indian participants with COVID-19 status and symptoms.

paper.label: Bhattacharya D et al. Sci Data 2023;10:397

items.name: WESAD
items.description: Wrist- and chest-worn multimodal sensor data (BVP, EDA, ECG, EMG, respiration, temperature, accelerometry) from 15 subjects during stress and amusement.

paper.label: Schmidt P et al. ICMI 2018

items.name: PPG-DaLiA
items.description: Wrist PPG, accelerometer and chest ECG from 15 subjects during daily-life activities for motion-robust heart-rate estimation.

paper.label: Reiss A et al. Sensors 2019;19:3079

items.name: LifeSnaps
items.description: Four months of Fitbit data (steps, sleep, heart rate, SpO2, temperature) plus surveys and ecological momentary assessments from 71 participants in the wild.

paper.label: Yfantidou S et al. Sci Data 2022;9:663

items.name: UCI Human Activity Recognition (Smartphones)
items.description: Smartphone accelerometer and gyroscope signals from 30 volunteers performing six daily activities — a classic activity-recognition dataset.

items.name: MIMIC-III-Ext-PPG
items.description: 4.9 million 30-second PPG segments from MIMIC-III ICU patients with rhythm labels, for PPG-based arrhythmia research.

items.name: EchoNext
items.description: 100,000 12-lead ECGs from Columbia University Irving Medical Center paired with echocardiography-derived structural heart disease labels.
items.access_note: PhysioNet account + signed data use agreement (restricted access).

paper.label: Poterucha TJ et al. Nature 2025

items.name: Bridge2AI-Voice
items.description: Voice and speech recordings with clinical data from participants with voice, neurological, respiratory and mood disorders (NIH Bridge2AI).
items.access_note: PhysioNet credentialing + DUA (derived features may be open).

items.name: COVID-19 Sounds
items.description: 53,449 breathing, cough and voice recordings from 36,116 participants with COVID-19 test status and symptoms.
items.access_note: Free; sign a data transfer agreement with Cambridge.

paper.label: Xia T et al. NeurIPS 2021 Datasets & Benchmarks

items.name: PADS (Parkinson's Disease Smartwatch)
items.description: Smartwatch accelerometer and gyroscope recordings from 469 participants (Parkinson's, differential diagnoses, healthy) during structured assessments.

items.name: Parkinson's Kaggle Challenges (AMP-PD & Freezing of Gait)
items.description: AMP-PD: longitudinal CSF protein/peptide data for progression prediction; FoG: lower-back accelerometry from lab, home and daily-living settings for freezing-of-gait detection.
items.provider: Accelerating Medicines Partnership / Michael J. Fox Foundation
items.access_note: Free Kaggle account and acceptance of competition rules.

items.name: Google Heart Rate Measurement (rPPG) Study Dataset
items.description: Facial videos with skin-tone measurements and reference heart rate for evaluating camera-based (remote PPG) heart-rate measurement across skin tones.
items.access_note: Details and download instructions on GitHub.

items.name: Propofol Anesthesia Dynamics
items.description: ECG and autonomic recordings from nine volunteers during propofol-induced loss and recovery of consciousness.

items.name: DCSM Sleep Staging Dataset
items.description: 255 anonymised overnight polysomnography recordings from the Danish Center for Sleep Medicine with expert sleep stages.

items.name: Dreem Open Datasets (DOD-H & DOD-O)
items.description: Polysomnography from 25 healthy adults and 55 obstructive sleep apnoea patients, each scored by five sleep technologists.

paper.label: Guillot A et al. IEEE Trans Neural Syst Rehabil Eng 2020;28:1955
